note: Removes scope-ceiling seeding and narrowing from core.py and adds login.py; both CODE_CHALLENGE_RE in core.py and the private _CODE_CHALLENGE_RE in views.py remain.
Deletes sync_next_run and all post_save signals on HogFlow/HogFlowSchedule so the scheduler alone owns next_run_at.
Adds an early return for hog evaluations in getProviderKeyIssue, so the wrapper now adds behaviour over getUnhealthyProviderKey.
Only reformats an import of health constants into a multi-line list; nothing is moved into a separate file.
Drops the top-level dataWarehouseTable globals field and puts the source table on event.properties.$source_table, matched by a consumer eligibility filter.
Deletes the local heavy-property set and imports HEAVY_PROPERTY_NAMES from posthog/hogql_queries/ai/utils.py instead.
Adds SCOPES_IMPLYING_FEATURE_FLAG_WRITE in scopes.tsx, used by both the scope warnings and the auto-select listener; the preset path is not changed.
Moves the flush out of shutdown into flushAndProduceMessages and makes shutdown throw on dirty entries; no cache class with per-batch tracking.
Removes the task-run artefact and links tasks through a new SignalReportTask model with a relationship type, not Task.signal_report plus origin_product.
Drops the postgres schema-propagation branch from the API serializer and replaces it with a config precedence change in the postgres source; CDC delete cleanup moves to the source too.
Adds a shared finish_node_run helper in sql_v2_runs.py and replaces the guarded update plus record logic in the view, direct run, and temporal activity.
Removes the evaluation-time check_ongoing_interval/condition guard from MetricsExtractor and relies on save-time validation.
Trims the README grouping docs to a pointer at bin/mprocs.yaml, not hogli, and disables the g binding when no group dimensions exist.
Extracts the setup status into a shared setupWizardStatusLogic that mounts installationProgressLogic for live progress; sampleDataStateLogic becomes a gate.
Moves the _WriteTracker dataclass and the inline helper functions to module level, sharing state through a new _CDCExtractContext dataclass.
Shows validation errors and an empty-table state in the trigger UI and skips the person lookup; does not force exit_only_at_end or add serializer checks.
Groups the seven reschedule fields into a single reschedule config object and updates every use.
Removes the unused InFlight variant from Outcome and its match arms, so Outcome holds only resolved states.
Adds paragraphs to the delete and update descriptions in the separate alerts yaml; the file is kept and the descriptions get longer.
Removes PreparedApply and EventSnapshot, inlines the key collection, multi_get, and zip in the loop, and keeps PriorState.
